title: Hessian-Aware Layer Pruning for Low-Rank Vision Transformers: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Vision transformers suffer from quadratic self-attention bottlenecks when deployed on embedded edge accelerators. We develop a second-order Hessian sensitivity pruning algorithm that selectively truncates redundant projection heads. On ImageNet-1K, the pruned ViT retains 81.4% top-1 accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 42.5% and inference latency to 11.2ms. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 2.1x and a verified task accuracy of 81.4% with mean execution latency of 11.2ms.
